examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A main action joined to a menu of related alternatives. Pressing the label runs `onClick`; the chevron opens the `actions`.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: `primary` is a solid fill and `secondary` is outlined.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Small, default and large, matching Button.

examples.title: With icons
examples.description: `icon` goes on the main button and each action can have its own icon.

examples.title: Destructive and disabled actions
examples.description: Mark risky actions `destructive` and unavailable ones `disabled`.

examples.title: Controlled menu
examples.description: `open` and `onOpenChange` let you control the menu; each action's `onSelect` runs when it is chosen.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabling the split button disables both halves.
